stations.title: Manual shirt load
stations.does: An operator places one laid-flat printed T-shirt onto the folding machine input.
steps: Operator removes one folded-free, laid-flat T-shirt from the input stack
Aligns T-shirt on the folding machine infeed footprint (centered, wrinkles flattened)
Places the T-shirt onto the folding machine input stop
Confirms the unit is ready (start signal for the fold cycle)

stations.title: Fold to 250×300 mm
stations.does: The machine folds the T-shirt to approximately 250 × 300 mm.
steps: Folding machine clamps the shirt edges at the designed reference points
First fold applied to reach the 300 mm dimension
Second fold applied to reach the 250 mm dimension
Machine releases clamps and moves folded shirt onto the next position on the conveyor

stations.title: Insert into poly bag
stations.does: The folded shirt is slipped into a poly bag.
steps: Bag presentation area feeds one open poly bag over the unit position
Operator (or pick mechanism) holds bag mouth open
Conveyor indexes the folded shirt to the bag opening center
Bag mouth is lowered over the folded shirt until fully inserted
Bag mouth is left upright for sealing

stations.title: Seal poly bag
steps: Bag neck/top area is positioned under the sealing jaws
Heat-seal jaws close and apply seal for a fixed dwell time
Jaws open and the sealed bag is released onto the conveyor lane
Seal integrity is checked via built-in seal status (pass/fail) before downstream

stations.title: Print & apply address label
stations.does: An address label is printed and stuck onto the sealed bag.
steps: System retrieves address for the current unit from the label queue
Label printer prints one address label
Tamp head picks and presses the label onto the designated bag panel
Label applicator performs brief dwell for adhesion
Unit advances with label surface facing the vision/verification zone at ST6

stations.title: QC + place into tote
stations.does: The labeled sealed bag is placed into a tote for the shipping area.
steps: QC operator inspects the unit: bag sealed (no open seam), label present, and label readable
If any QC check fails, operator removes the bad unit from the line (reject path) and clears the position
If QC passes, operator places the labeled bag into the correct tote cavity/position
Operator triggers release/confirm for the tote slot so the tote continues to fill

notes: Takt is 9 s/unit (400/h). Label print/apply (ST5) and QC/place (ST6) are budgeted at the takt limit; the builder should ensure the label printhead/transfer and QC method (manual vs vision-assisted) reliably complete within 9 s.
This line assumes the folding machine, bag insertion, and sealing are synchronized with single-unit indexing so ST3–ST6 never receive a backlog.
Rejection is implemented inside the ST6 operation (as part of PlaceBagIntoTote) to match the provided brief step list.
